notes.title: New patch for The Bugs Manor Prologue
notes.content:
A new patch has been released with multiple improvements for the prologue of The Bugs Manor:

Control improvements:
	- The input for grabbing objects has been changed from pressing two buttons to pressing only one.
	- An option has been added to disable the need to hold the button to carry the object; now you can press once to grab/release it.
	- RPGMaker-style controls have been added, allowing play using the arrow keys and the Z, X, C, and Space keys.

The exterior of the house has been optimized to reduce FPS drops.

Two new deaths and secrets await in the manor.

Multiple minor bugs in the game have been fixed, along with small experience improvements.

Russian language has been added to the game.

notes.title: The Bugs Manor Prologue is Available!
notes.content:
The Bugs Manor demo is now available!, it's a prologue that takes place a few years before the main story, where Mike, Julia and Andrea face the dark mysteries and terrifying creatures of the mansion.

I hope you enjoy it!
